product_audience: Professionals in the United States preparing for a promotion or compensation conversation; available for iPhone
editorial_audience: Early-career professionals navigating first jobs, workplace relationships, skills, confidence, sustainable work, career choices, job search, workplace change, and advancement
website_copy_rule: Omit minimum-age and age-eligibility qualifiers from public website and blog copy, including titles, summaries, body text, calls to action, and metadata. Do not reintroduce them from legal pages, historical articles, or examples. This is an editorial preference and does not change app eligibility or privacy-policy rules. Use Available for iPhone in the United States when an availability line is relevant.
price: One-time US in-app purchase of $24.99 for one case per account; no subscription required for this purchase
journey: Approve one Evidence example in each of five Case Check areas: results, teamwork, leadership, bigger responsibilities, and strategic impact; each example supports one area
Review the offer, separately authorize AI preparation, and complete the in-app purchase
Review both documents, make supported edits, and approve email delivery of two PDFs
ai: Evidence can be saved without AI drafting; optional AI drafting and purchased document preparation have explicit permissions identifying OpenAI
pay_context: Published US national occupation benchmarks, or clearly labeled age-adjusted national earnings context when a reliable occupation match is unavailable; estimates, not exact valuations
restore: Restores access to the existing purchased case, not another case
privacy: Employer cannot access the private account through the app; the customer chooses what to share
limitations: No guaranteed promotion, raise, salary, or employment outcome
do_not_claim: general AI career coach or unlimited career chat
editorial_rule: No brand mention or product CTA is required. Broad career articles should provide useful advice without a product pitch. In directly relevant advancement or pay articles, a product connection is optional and limited to one short paragraph of one or two sentences, at most 60 words. These facts constrain claims, not topic selection, and should not be copied wholesale into articles. Historical examples are not authoritative product facts. Link only to known live destinations. Do not fabricate customer stories, outcomes, citations, or the author's personal experience. Clearly label hypothetical examples.
